title: Halving instruction phases
statement: For natural numbers $a,b,f$ and a phase $j$ among three phases, define an instruction as follows: at phase $0$, test whether register $4$ is zero, continuing to the copy site that transfers register $13$ to register $3$ if so and to phase $1$ otherwise; at phase $1$, decrement register $4$ and continue to phase $2$; at phase $2$, halve register $13$ and return to phase $0$.
